text:
Zoe: Quick heads-up  Junie's birthday next Wed. Two low-effort pick options for hybrid folks: insulated travel mug (practical + ships) or mini terrarium kit (cute desk thing, also ship-friendly). Thoughts?
Nina: Mug  everyone uses them and lower breakage risk.
Sam: Terrarium is adorable but some plants need sunlight. Are there any plant allergies we should worry about?
Yvonne: Mug vote. also easier to brand with a tiny Redwood sticker.
people-ops-bot: :ballot_box: Poll started  mug 2, terrarium 1, undecided 0
Diego: Mug sounds great. Budget note: insulated mugs ~ $18 each + $6 shipping for certain regions. Terrarium kits approx $22 + $8 fragile packaging.
Zoe: We have $200 in the birthday fund. Junie has 7 remotes. Mug option fits budget better.
Nina: If we do mugs, can we add a small plantable seed-paper card? low-cost, shipping-friendly.
Yvonne: Love seed-paper idea. Also suggest "no stickers" on mugs for EU shipments if customs are picky?
people-ops-bot: :memo: Reminder set: "Order 8 travel mugs + seed cards" at 1932120000.
Sam: I'll handle the artwork for the sticker-less label and coordinate with fulfillment.
Diego: I'll compile shipping addresses and note EU customs preferences. DM me your address if you haven't added it to the sheet.
Zoe: Final tally mug 4, terrarium 1. Mugs it is. Will post sign-up for packing helpers.
Nina: Optional extra: anyone want to chip $3 for a small add-on (choc bar)? Drop in Venmo @redwood-bday.
people-ops-bot: :tada: Thread closed  plan=mugs+seed-card, budget_est=$200, remotes=7, owners=[Sam,Diego]
